headline_findings.summary: vLLM aggregate throughput ~31 to ~1432 tok/s from concurrency 1 to 32 (~45.6x).
Prefill latency ~6.3x and extra peak memory ~32x from 32 to 1024 prompt tokens.
NF4 reduced model footprint ~63.7% but generation was ~2.24x slower than FP16.
Transformers explicit batch 1→8 raised aggregate tok/s from ~12 to ~206.

recommendations.transformers_latency_baseline: FP16 + SDPA (workload-dependent; faster than NF4 in Phase 9)
recommendations.serving_throughput_this_benchmark: vLLM achieved higher aggregate throughput as concurrency increased

throughput_definition: aggregate = total generated tokens / wall time, unless noted
